LanguageData.Gun_Browning_Auto-5_RWP.label: Browning Auto-5
LanguageData.Gun_Browning_Auto-5_RWP.description: The Browning Auto-5 is a semi-automatic shotgun known for its reliability and durability. It features a distinct humpback design that accommodates its unique long recoil action. With a modest fire rate and significant stopping power, this weapon is well-suited for close-quarters combat, making it a valuable choice for hunters and defenders alike.
